description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Village Bell-Ringer from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Village Bell-Ringer by paying {2}{W}.
Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.
